Evidence record

What the Yemen Findex 2021 study contains

What does this evidence establish?

The verified Yemen Global Findex 2021 study has 1,000 respondents and 113 variables; Yemen fieldwork ran from 7 November 2022 to 9 January 2023 and all population estimates require survey weights.

What does it measure?

This record describes the Yemen Findex 2021 study file (1,000 respondents, 113 variables, survey weights, documented coverage and fieldwork from 7 November 2022 to 9 January 2023); it reports no population value.

Who or what does it apply to?

The Yemen Findex study file contains 1,000 respondents and 113 variables; population inference applies only through the survey design, weights and documented coverage.

When was it measured or observed?

Global Findex 2021 wave; Yemen fieldwork 7 November 2022 to 9 January 2023.

How current is it?

This description applies to the Findex 2021 study of Yemen, with fieldwork from 7 November 2022 to 9 January 2023. It changes only if the World Bank revises the study documentation or file, or a newer Yemen wave is published.

What this evidence does not establish

Raw case percentages in the study documentation are not population estimates.

Method and verification detailDetail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Taken from the World Bank study metadata for the Yemen Findex 2021 file, including its variable documentation. Population estimates are produced only with the survey weights; raw case percentages are not population estimates.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference.
